lede: It's a holiday week, so the government calendar is quiet — no agendas have been posted for any of the four scheduled meetings, meaning no public decisions to track right now. What the week does have is community: Alpine Chapel's free Friendsgiving on Sunday, the Turkey Trot on Thanksgiving morning, and a People's March on Saturday for anyone who wants to show up for something beyond the dinner table. Enjoy the valley and the people in it.
